# Research Notes: HubSpot Toolkit Buildability

### 1. Product Overview
HubSpot is an all-in-one customer platform that unifies marketing, sales, customer service, content management, data management, and operations software.
* **Source URL:** `https://legal.hubspot.com/hubspot-product-and-services-catalog`
* **Verbatim Quote:** `"the hubspot customer platform all of hubspot's marketing, sales, and customer service software on one agentic platform."`

---

### 2. Authentication Methods
HubSpot supports multiple authentication methods depending on the integration type, though legacy API keys have been completely deprecated.
* **OAuth 2.0:** Used for public applications and multi-tenant integrations.
  * **Source URL:** `https://developers.hubspot.com/docs/apps/legacy-apps/authentication/working-with-oauth`
  * **Verbatim Quote:** `"oauth is a secure means of authentication for your app. it uses authorization tokens rather than a password"`
* **Private App Access Tokens / Service Keys:** Used for single-account, system-to-system integrations.
  * **Source URL (Private Apps):** `https://developers.hubspot.com/docs/apps/legacy-apps/private-apps/overview`
  * **Verbatim Quote:** `"private apps allow you to use hubspot’s apis to access specific data from your hubspot account... which will generate an access token that’s unique to your app."`
  * **Source URL (Service Keys):** `https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQF43-t6Cw1ZjUpLgIfzTV2yI_l2H7WApZFN8rppOUYtzi9pUGjZdMetTuqB3412hQpAELObOTJO6emoC5F-elAFiGT8GnlKitgTAKvMZfwwVeT8PD8zq4TYNn7khB1UewdmHt-5oMJmG8cp8gX3caZ3MebVsUSeIA==`
  * **Verbatim Quote:** `"Service keys (public beta): the replacement for legacy private apps with scoped API access for in-account integrations"`
* **API Keys (Sunsetted):** Deprecated in late 2022.
  * **Source URL:** `https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQHgVEoI5HX-fvABAnu4yTiBQ3D66__2D4qHlg3XizRXHOO4y4cBl-1NKKc2FU3HpiIlANfELi9Nz7ZIwjNhRQi2rG28VE5SqLI72QsdMQQk6fyIfuRmejwL0SF6NedyJkdcaHrRhAj6fE7FjWaAR4Lb2kuVUxdjR3wWZjk=`
  * **Verbatim Quote:** `"After November 30, we will begin the process of deprecating API Keys and your API keys will no longer be supported by HubSpot."`

* **Multi-Tenant Integration Choice:** A multi-tenant platform like Composio must use OAuth 2.0.
  * **Source URL:** `https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQH-c4SEp_HOPc3gSTth56rm5JbeMbiH_YE8B8h_O5NOvesbfwIiMXvBf1UWKycDmdSY_8q6wxs21K8BMvtZQjvKG1jH6vBbfk6vjukGnmi4jh8Bqh0KPrJej1WT1GAy9RzOm0nGmP33rKCzatI4Gt01juifkgIq9JtUun7p0LuHfeKe8mRltOhcigJt`
  * **Verbatim Quote:** `"For multiple accounts, the app route also requires OAuth."`
* **Primary Auth Mode:** `oauth2`

---

### 3. Developer Credentials & Cost
Developers can sign up for a free developer account to create public applications and manage test environments at no cost.
* **How to get credentials:** Sign up at `developers.hubspot.com` and create a public app from the developer dashboard to obtain a Client ID and Client Secret.
  * **Source URL:** `https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQG4sjof9S-e7XG3LurM_ftQfU1B0j8_PVCkzzGO197EAQcBkjLcJI4ma0EK1A8Dg69cTZRi4PRoPrSBmiWuyH7ZGUM8bQ-XDWxvHpXkZ1HaA1I3vsmy4bMQI3FC56y_4mEoC9qJJi0DA3WwUHj1IJniZv3PyNbz-VzK43IjgxlE0ezf_HrrWKHGuVPo4yc58DsA3lGQDpTeqYirAAIKw9akhp05QE8yAM4D9WS_M_zv64YzTy-BpknC`
  * **Verbatim Quote:** `"Sign into your HubSpot developer account at developers.hubspot.com... From the dashboard you can click the Create an app button to create your OAuth app."`
* **Cost / Plan Requirements:** Free. Developer accounts and test portals do not require a paid subscription.
  * **Source URL (Free Account):** `https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYGo-0kMQ0VAqnScJqpNqc_bfkwOajxPRe0zY0mzWtkv2C7cHZEJE_KS6q5n1KNIw7agPkoLgwRGO7gsXnFZl-BvVECTjQCq4TS_M6ABR1780utJRbVunBnGhlk=`
  * **Verbatim Quote:** `"Get started with a free account."`
  * **Source URL (Test Accounts):** `https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQH21K-RvRBmiY7iYJaDmIJ3UwFuZUTe2wPTNUo-lXkj7NxnBhSSO0VqaZ_eys5dyzae50WSWp5Q1DhrscT2twpVsBBefiCweh049M6GU6RrGT1tqhIT1IDsZRwfM1T7H5HX7Du7D1isgl6AGcfMOc_7kc2aEApSeQhml1wQ`
  * **Verbatim Quote:** `"Create a developer test account. To create a developer test account in your HubSpot account: In your HubSpot account, navigate to Development. In the left sidebar menu, navigate to Testing > Test Accounts."`
* **Access Level:** `self_serve_free`

---

### 4. API Technical Details
* **API Style:** REST APIs utilizing a date-based versioning scheme.
  * **Source URL:** `https://developers.hubspot.com/docs/api-reference/latest/overview`
  * **Verbatim Quote:** `"the 2026-09 apis use a date-based versioning scheme (e.g., /crm/2026-09/ ) that follows the previous 2026-03 api version . all endpoints in this section follow the pattern: /api-name/2026-09/resource"`
* **Breadth:** Extremely broad, covering CRM objects (contacts, companies, deals, tickets), marketing, sales, service, content, data management, and commerce.
  * **Source URL:** `https://legal.hubspot.com/hubspot-product-and-services-catalog`
  * **Verbatim Quote:** `"marketing hub... sales hub... service hub... content hub... data hub... revenue hub"`
* **OpenAPI Spec:** Officially available via public repositories and Postman workspaces.
  * **Source URL:** `https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQEJBVDVl95dHlomG4ki_Wvh7wKLaxsoBjL_VjWOQJ5lGuI9THpYHqlAf6gMvV0V-KPormsGAEmVVSmQzCTzMN7Tr0lGIK9IRQ0sHnpRSLio43bVy1IBuyQrf5hPJoOWVk1heV4Y7vVjulgE-xayMIR81bKNWRtXH3k=`
  * **Verbatim Quote:** `"This repository contains the Open API 3.0 schema for HubSpot's public APIs and is integrated with HubSpot's Public API Postman Workspace."`
* **Webhooks:** Fully supported, including a Next-Gen Webhooks Journal API.
  * **Source URL:** `https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQF7cMwSoDtN2T1zPP9EdQMr1qcx17srN9STqRZ9SEccCsJVQ1giyuS5Fc2yZrIJrCFQo1RILongxp85B_dXHI3bdvHSf_8-DKrNpoI7q682rTEq-AoS01wOm0O-SYxqnIJTbHlFm6sbfwEDHSFlqJNdWFzM667VUcyNiEElS08LmdqnWPLk`
  * **Verbatim Quote:** `"Next-Gen Webhooks We've overhauled our webhooks for improved performance and reliability. We're introducing the Webhooks Journal API in beta."`
* **Sandbox:** Supported via Standard Sandboxes and Developer Test Accounts.
  * **Source URL:** `https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQEA7r_3Kxg_bhFVVRWMfBAmcwnYSqcJdXrEc2qVbO1S_2skT-4rThW8MQWVDe_W-7cnsx7RJkskQfNtKDgbWsUnCnQz7P2yqw9DLIuiojzz7HeEfggnLQpC25YOB5573oWTzkmePxeR1f1Irl7ia-gAyUphecqnJlLWlzA=`
  * **Verbatim Quote:** `"On December 15, 2025, HubSpot launched an improved Standard Sandbox with a new Deploy to Production feature."`

---

### 5. Model Context Protocol (MCP) Servers
HubSpot provides official Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, including a publicly hosted remote endpoint for AI agents to interact directly with CRM records.
* **MCP Availability:** `official`
* **Source URL (Server Types):** `https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQFUEbbIDPipF70C7svwdiOsWNwTRislHLjQvIH7iByymY4XsrTKAHTbXUKGz2zCDFEaqWwOrF1dHkxSKRXUZbkIoFbL6cQKDaXFYl_zVXwKWGnAvYwpclWMGZcu2R9HRQ6wrToXUgk=`
* **Verbatim Quote:** `"HubSpot offers two distinct MCP servers that act as secure gateways for AI agents and tools. The HubSpot MCP Server (Remote)... Developer MCP Server (Local)..."`
* **Source URL (Remote Endpoint):** `https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQFY5VvmCWN6JumoAhXPAs5psAidTygHL6iAgb0RRdwCcm8ZiDGJovPywkl35-o_QMN6hmuyB4uOf2MyL5Vs4lMPu_19npICC_N-AS8UOyAsCe605O4zDizTLTz_gNAKHDf4XhJH2mAKiFeSS2HN_xbEB3_87Ehg74W4OqnDn0g=`
* **Verbatim Quote:** `"Enter the HubSpot MCP server URL provided by HubSpot ( https://mcp.hubspot.com ). Authorize the connection by signing in to your HubSpot account when prompted."`

---

### 6. Buildability Verdict
* **Verdict:** `ready_now`
* **Main Blocker:** None. HubSpot provides self-serve free developer accounts, comprehensive REST APIs, official OpenAPI 3.0 specifications, robust testing sandboxes, and a publicly hosted official MCP server endpoint (`https://mcp.hubspot.com`). Composio can ship an agent toolkit immediately.
